title: CounterSketch XAML and source input/event hookup coverage
evidenceType: static source and supplemental recovered markup; no target execution
limitations: XAML comes from desktop-xaml; installer-studio remains baseline. An exact x:Class + method match proves a name/body correspondence, not identical build identity or runtime invocation.

Attribute inventory uses lexical XML tag/attribute recovery and an explicit input/lifecycle/event-name predicate. Property-valued bindings and boolean/property attributes are excluded; unusual custom event names outside the predicate may remain absent.

Source +=/-= scan is bounded to inventoried UI/input/control surfaces and viewmodels. Timer lifecycle and Changed handlers are included; unrelated service-proxy completions are not a claim of UI coverage.

Routed AddHandler/RemoveHandler and anonymous delegates retain expressions and AST containing-member locations. Dynamic registration/reflection, inherited handlers and third-party event implementation can remain unresolved.

EventTrigger records include animation/presentation triggers; a trigger is not counted as an independent user feature. Feature association can be exact evidence, command-derived, or explicitly labeled surface grouping.
Duplicate XAML/source hookups are retained as separate evidence records; raw hookup counts are not distinct end-user feature counts.

representativeMethodBodiesInspected.behavior: Escape returns to tiles; Ctrl+S/Z/Y save/undo/redo; debug shortcuts are profile gated.
300 ms debounced quick graph update, full update on release, expanded slider bounds stored in graph user data.
Dual-range UI writes control values through quick/full graph notification route.
Gem table dimensions update on slider; numeric custom inputs parse invariant culture and mark custom size.
Flip and mirror selection encode Value1/Value2 and send full graph update.
NURBS control-point/profile editing and zoom depend on native core curve APIs.
Persists UI/preferences, updates ring standard and rounding/core performance state; currency refresh uses remote exchange service.
Serial format validation and SecurityHelper authentication; no offline success proved.
Sets ProceedWithOrder and closes confirmation modal.

gaps.description: Supplemental markup or source hook names have no exact baseline declaring-type method match; inspect build/version and generated delegate wiring before inferring behavior.
Input/lifecycle/presentation hook inventoried but no justified existing feature association. Handler/source evidence retained; behavioral requirement not inferred from event or class name.
Inline delegates, routed event instances and dynamic AddHandler expressions are retained with containing-member evidence. Their existence does not establish invocation or complete delegate capture.
